channel.title: The Christian Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Texas AG Ken Paxton sets up 'tip line' to help public report 'mentally ill men' in women's restrooms
item.description: A new initiative launched by the Texas Office of the Attorney General is aimed at helping citizens stop “mentally ill men” from entering women's restrooms in public spaces. #Texas #AttorneyGeneral #KenPaxton #BathroomBill #LGBT

item.title: Hegseth calls for overhaul of military Chaplain Corps, eliminates 'New Age' 'spiritual fitness guide'
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth says he is planning a significant overhaul of the military's Chaplain Corps by refocusing it on religious ministry and eliminating what he called secular influences. #PeteHegseth #DepartmentofWar #ChaplainCorps

item.title: Greg Locke threatens lawsuit after former pastors allege 'spiritual abuse,' lack of accountability
item.description: Outspoken Tennessee Pastor Greg Locke has mentioned the possibility of taking legal action as he faces allegations from former pastors of the Lebanon-based Global Vision Bible Church that he inflicted “spiritual abuse” on church employees and has not been transparent with the use of church finances, a claim he denies. #GregLocke #GlobalVisionBibleChurch #Tennessee

item.title: In ‘Hazel’s Heart,’ 'The Chosen' star Stelio Savante brings forgotten American heroine to screen
item.description: “The Chosen” star Stelio Savante says his new film, “Hazel’s Heart,” based on the true story of a teenage girl’s faith and sacrifice during a deadly 1920 blizzard, is a faith-fueled survival drama he hopes will introduce a forgotten American heroine to a national audience. #StelioSavante #HazelsHeart #TheChosen #Angel

item.title: Former pastor John-Paul Miller indicted for cyberstalking estranged wife before her death
item.description: A former pastor in South Carolina has been indicted on federal charges for allegedly cyberstalking his estranged wife in the months leading up to her death and lying to investigators. John-Paul Miller, 46, is scheduled to appear in federal court next month. #SouthCarolina #JohnPaulMiller #MicaMiller

item.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announces HHS crackdown on 'sex-rejecting' surgeries for minors: 'Malpractice'
item.description: Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced Thursday that the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services is taking six steps to push back against what he described as "sex-rejecting" transgender procedures for minors. #RobertFKennedyJr #HealthandHumanServices #transgender #health

item.title: St. Andrew's Chapel, founded by RC Sproul, votes overwhelmingly to leave PCA
item.description: St. Andrew's Chapel, which was founded by the late theologian R.C. Sproul in 1997, overwhelmingly voted earlier this week to leave the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA) after just two years in the denomination. #RCSproul #PresbyterianChurchinAmerica #BurkParsons

item.title: Woman high on fentanyl, meth and marijuana when she killed California pastor: DA
item.description: A California woman was under the influence of fentanyl, methamphetamine and marijuana when she fatally struck a pastor riding a bicycle and seriously injured two others in October, prosecutors said this week. She now faces upgraded felony charges that could result in more than a decade in prison. #PastorEricWilliams #AmberCalderon #California #Fentanyl #Methamphetamine #Marijuana #carcrash

item.title: Richard Land criticizes Trump’s remarks in light of unimaginable tragedy of Reiner family
item.description: Dr. Richard Land, executive editor of The Christian Post and president emeritus of Southern Evangelical Seminary in Charlotte, North Carolina, criticized a recent social media post President Donald Trump made in response to the gruesome deaths of director Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele. #RobReiner #RichardLand #DonaldTrump

item.title: Trump's week in review: Pentagon worship service, year-end address to the nation
item.description: This week saw President Donald Trump offer his assessment of the first year of his second term as he received pushback for his reaction to the death of outspoken liberal critic Rob Reiner. His administration also celebrated Christmas and took action to discourage hospitals from performing "sex-rejecting" trans surgeries on children. #RobReiner #DonaldTrump #DepartmentofWar #FranklinGraham #PeteHegseth #RFK #HHS
